discovery.minorant_rule: h_i -> round_60(h_i) (i>=1); h_0 -> floor_60(h_0 - sum_{i>=1}|err_i| - 1e-60); hence h_new <= h_old - 1e-60 on [-1,1]
discovery.factor_rule: each factor entry rounded to the nearest multiple of 10^-D (half-even); shapes unchanged
discovery.raw_energy_rule: ceil_60(arb upper bound of Phi(energy_midpoint)); Phi = P9-family energy
